scope: Follow-up to the active/inactive DomainOS window-decoration color comparison
user_observation: The active orange/coral and inactive green/teal decoration still appear slightly lighter than the original VM.
interpretation: The reported appearance remains a valid human observation, but the saved captures show pixel-identical solid faces and sampled bevels. R241 therefore does not support a color-value correction. The remaining uncertainty is perceptual/rendering context (for example, display path or comparison state), not a measured face-color delta.
action: No palette or source change. Keep KDE semantic-role binding. Reopen this comparison only with a new aligned capture/state that can distinguish face color from rendering context.
coverage: I167 remains at 78% technical coverage; this follow-up does not complete a control family or establish visual acceptance.
